saw_lines: Buyers pick a photo puzzle as a gift tied to one occasion, so the occasion is what sells it.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line, where the occasion must be named before the scroll.
Your 30 ads carry no proof number, so new buyers have no reason to trust the order. Collect one count, such as orders shipped, and open the next batch with it.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 27 Oct 2026
points: None of your 30 ads shows a proof number, so a new buyer has nothing concrete to trust before clicking. Collect one real figure, such as orders shipped, and open three new video ads with it in line one.

11 of your 30 copy ads open on the same 24 Türchen line, so the account repeats one story to the same buyers. Test two new openers against it, one about the gift moment and one about choosing the piece count.

16 ads have run 60 days or more, yet none of the 14 newer ads reuses a winner’s opening line, so each launch starts from zero. Build the next three ads as variations of the oldest winner, the Italian gift video.

Shop now sits on 17 ads, Order now on 11 and See details on 2, so one buyer gets mixed signals. Keep Order now on the advent calendar ads, Shop now on the photo puzzle ads, and retire the See details ads.
